definition.title: What Is an AI UGC Video Ad Generator?
paras: This tool makes a short ad from a product photo, a few words you type about the scene, or a product link. You get a script, an AI actor, a voice, captions and a finished clip. You do not film it, and you do not need another editing app.

Each ad can be a tall phone (9:16), a square (1:1) or a wide shape (16:9). 3:4 is tall, but 9:16 is taller. Post on TikTok, Facebook or Instagram, or download the file. You can use it in paid ads and in your own posts. No logo is stamped on it. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: What is an AI UGC video ads generator?
faq.a: It makes a short ad that looks like a person filmed it on a phone. Start from a product photo, a few words you type, or a product link. You also get a script, an AI actor, a voice and captions. You do not film it.

faq.q: How do I make a video ad here?
faq.a: Start from a product page or one clear photo. The script, actor and voice are created for you. Edit what you want, then download it or post it on TikTok, Facebook or Instagram.

faq.q: What is the best AI video generator for ads?
faq.a: Use AIVideosUGC when you have a product photo or a product link and you want several ads in that phone style. Sizes are a tall 9:16, a square 1:1, a wide 16:9, plus 4:3 and 3:4. You can also make one ad for each product in a list.

faq.q: Is an AI UGC video ad free to make?
faq.a: No. Plans start at $24.50 a month. Credits are what the plan spends on each video. Six seconds uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. You see that number before you start.

faq.q: Do I own the rights to the video ads I make?
faq.a: You can use finished clips in paid ads and in posts you publish yourself. No logo is stamped on them.

faq.q: What sizes and platforms can I make ads for?
faq.a: Choose a tall 9:16, a square 1:1, a wide 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Those fit TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook and Instagram. You can post to TikTok, Facebook or Instagram from the same screen.

faq.q: Can I make a video ad for every product at once?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product links, or connect the products from your shop, and make an ad for each one. You do not have to start every clip by hand.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives one action a clear beginning and end.

faq.q: How many credits does a video ad cost?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. Credits are what your plan spends. If a video fails, those credits come back on their own.

faq.q: Can an AI video ad replace one filmed by a creator?
faq.a: It depends on the product and who you sell to. Use these clips to try more opening lines. Book a real creator when you need a filmed ad.

faq.q: Will Facebook, Instagram or TikTok mark ads made with AI?
faq.a: Check the current rules on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok before you spend more on ads. Say the video is AI when an app asks you to, especially if shoppers might think a real buyer filmed it.

faq.q: Is the person on screen a real customer?
faq.a: No. The person on screen is made by AI, not a real customer. Keep the scene true to the product. Say the video is AI when an app requires it.

faq.q: Can I change captions, the voice or the music?
faq.a: Yes. Captions are written with the script, and you can edit them. You can swap the voice. Pick a song from the music list, or add your own music if you have the rights to it, before you post.

faq.q: Can my own shop tool ask for ads (an API)?
faq.a: Yes. An API is a connection that lets your own tool ask for ads from your product list. Each clip still uses credits, and you see that cost before it starts.
